question: Should CodexBar add a first-party usage-sharing surface, and should its card represent every visible account or only the selected account?
rationale: VISION.md requires sign-off for this new privacy-sensitive feature, while the account-scope choice determines both its product meaning and implementation boundary.

options.title: Approve an account-aware card
options.body: Ship the local-only feature after every visible account is represented or intentionally aggregated, with clear provenance and runtime proof.

options.title: Approve selected-account export
options.body: Narrow the feature to the currently selected account and make that limitation prominent in the card and action labels.

options.title: Decline the sharing surface
options.body: Keep CodexBar focused on monitoring and omit a first-party social-export workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve an account-aware card
recommendation.body: Ship the local-only feature after every visible account is represented or intentionally aggregated, with clear provenance and runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the vision policy and is best positioned to decide the permanent product and account-scope contract.
